    if(inside(province.cx,province.cy))return true;
    const coordinates=/([ML])(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?),(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/g;let match,prior;
    while((match=coordinates.exec(province.path))){const x=+match[2],y=+match[3];if(inside(x,y))return true;
      if(match[1]==='L'&&prior){
        let low=0,high=1;const dx=x-prior[0],dy=y-prior[1],p=[-dx,dx,-dy,dy],q=[prior[0]-bounds[0],bounds[2]-prior[0],prior[1]-bounds[1],bounds[3]-prior[1]];
        for(let i=0;i<4&&low<=high;i++){if(!p[i]){if(q[i]<0){low=1;high=0;}}else{const t=q[i]/p[i];if(p[i]<0)low=Math.max(low,t);else high=Math.min(high,t);}}
        if(low<=high)return true;
      }
      prior=[x,y];
    }
    return false;
  }
  function withinRing(x,y,ring){let inside=false;for(let i=0,j=ring.length-1;i<ring.length;j=i++){
    const a=ring[i],b=ring[j];if((a[1]>y)!==(b[1]>y)&&x<(b[0]-a[0])*(y-a[1])/(b[1]-a[1])+a[0])inside=!inside;
  }return inside;}
  function lookupMask(era,lon,lat){
    for(const feature of masks[era]||[]){const b=feature.b;if(lon<b[0]||lon>b[2]||lat<b[1]||lat>b[3])continue;
      for(const polygon of feature.p)if(withinRing(lon,lat,polygon[0])&&!polygon.slice(1).some(ring=>withinRing(lon,lat,ring)))return feature;
    }return null;
  }
  function historicalOwner(era,province){
    if(era==='modern')return province.owner;
    const lon=province.cx/6-180,lat=90-province.cy/6;
    if(era==='1592'){
      if(province.owner==='kor'||province.owner==='prk')return'joseon';
      if(province.owner==='jpn'){
        if(lat>=41.5)return'ainu';
        if(lon>128.8&&lon<129.7&&lat>33.9&&lat<34.9)return'tsushima';
        if(lon<131&&lat<29.5)return'ryukyu';
        return lat>=29.5?'japan':'unassigned';
      }
      if(province.owner==='mng')return'mongol';
      if(province.owner==='chn'&&lon>=120&&lat>=41.5)return'jurchen';
      const feature=lookupMask('1419',lon,lat);
      if(feature&&feature.o==='ming'&&province.owner==='chn')return'ming';
      if(feature&&['jianzhou','odori'].includes(feature.o))return'jurchen';
      if(feature&&['tatar','oirat'].includes(feature.o))return'mongol';
      return'unassigned';
    }
    if(era==='1754'){
      if(province.owner==='kor'||province.owner==='prk')return'joseon';
      if(province.owner==='jpn'&&lat>=41.5)return'ainu';
      if(province.owner==='jpn'&&lon<131&&lat<29.5)return'ryukyu';
    }
    const feature=lookupMask(era,lon,lat);
    if(!feature)return'unassigned';
    if(era==='1754'){
      if(feature.i==='korea')return'joseon';
      if(feature.i==='japan'&&lat>=41.5)return'ainu';
      if(province.owner==='jpn'&&lon<131&&lat<29.5)return'ryukyu';
    }
    return feature.o==='other'?'unassigned':feature.o;
  }
  function ownersFor(era){
    if(ownerCaches.has(era))return ownerCaches.get(era);
    const owners=new Map();for(const province of originalGet('world-detailed').provinces)owners.set(province.id,historicalOwner(era,province));
    ownerCaches.set(era,owners);return owners;
  }
  function countryRegistry(){
    if(countries)return countries;
    const byId=new Map(originalGet('world-detailed').countries.map(country=>[country.id,Object.assign({},country)]));
    for(const id of ['eastasia1419','world1754'])for(const country of originalGet(id)?.countries||[])byId.set(country.id,Object.assign({},country));
    for(const country of extraCountries)byId.set(country.id,country);
    if(byId.has('native'))byId.set('native',Object.assign({},byId.get('native'),{name:'원주민 여러 사회'}));
    countries=Array.from(byId.values());return countries;
  }
  function sourceProvinces(region){
    if(regionProvinces.has(region.id))return regionProvinces.get(region.id);
    const membership=memberships[region.id];
    const belongs=province=>{
      if(!membership)return true;
      if(!membership.has(province.owner))return false;
      const lon=province.cx/6-180,lat=90-province.cy/6;
      if(region.id==='north_america'){
        if(province.owner==='fra'&&lat<12)return false; // French Guiana belongs in South America.
        if(province.owner==='usa'&&lat<20&&lon< -130)return false; // Pacific islands.
        if(province.owner==='col'&&!(lat>=12&&lon< -79))return false; // San Andres / Providencia only.
      }
      if(region.id==='south_america'&&province.owner==='fra'&&lat>=8)return false;
      return true;
    };
    const bounds=boundsFor(region),items=originalGet('world-detailed').provinces.filter(province=>belongs(province)&&intersects(provinceBounds(province),bounds)&&pathTouches(province,bounds));
    regionProvinces.set(region.id,items);return items;
  }
  function regionalTemplate(id,chosen){
    if(templates.has(id))return templates.get(id);
    const source=originalGet('world-detailed');if(!source)return null;
    const region=regionDefinitions.find(item=>item.id===chosen.regionId),era=eraDefinitions[chosen.eraId],bounds=boundsFor(region),[offsetX,offsetY]=bounds,width=bounds[2]-offsetX,height=bounds[3]-offsetY,owners=ownersFor(chosen.eraId),ownedBounds=new Map();
    const provinces=sourceProvinces(region).map(province=>{
      const bbox=provinceBounds(province),local=[Math.max(0,bbox[0]-offsetX),Math.max(0,bbox[1]-offsetY),Math.min(width,bbox[2]-offsetX),Math.min(height,bbox[3]-offsetY)],owner=owners.get(province.id);
      const out=Object.assign({},province,{owner,bbox:local,cx:Math.max(local[0],Math.min(local[2],province.cx-offsetX)),cy:Math.max(local[1],Math.min(local[3],province.cy-offsetY))});
      if(chosen.eraId!=='modern')delete out.influence;
      const prior=ownedBounds.get(owner);ownedBounds.set(owner,prior?[Math.min(prior[0],local[0]),Math.min(prior[1],local[1]),Math.max(prior[2],local[2]),Math.max(prior[3],local[3])]:local.slice());
      return out;
    });
    const localCountries=countryRegistry().map(country=>{
      const owned=ownedBounds.get(country.id),out=Object.assign({},country,{available:!!owned});
      delete out.focusBounds;
      if(owned){
        const fb=country.focusBounds;
        out.focusBounds=fb&&intersects(fb,bounds)?[Math.max(0,fb[0]-offsetX),Math.max(0,fb[1]-offsetY),Math.min(width,fb[2]-offsetX),Math.min(height,fb[3]-offsetY)]:owned.slice();
      }
      return out;
    });
    const template=Object.assign({},source,{id,name:region.name+' · '+era.name,width,height,offsetX,offsetY,regionId:region.id,eraId:era.id,geographicBounds:region.bounds.slice(),provinces,countries:localCountries,notice:era.notice+' 지역 범위는 직사각형으로 잘라 제공하며 가장자리에는 이웃 대륙 일부가 포함될 수 있습니다. 세부 소유권·국가명·색은 지도 편집에서 수정할 수 있습니다.'});
    templates.set(id,template);return template;
  }
  registry.get=id=>{const chosen=selection(id);return chosen?regionalTemplate(id,chosen):originalGet(id);};
  registry.regions=()=>regionDefinitions.map(region=>({id:region.id,name:region.name,defaultEra:region.defaultEra}));
  registry.eras=regionId=>regionDefinitions.some(region=>region.id===regionId)?eras(regionId):[];
  registry.regionalId=regionalId;
  registry.selection=selection;
  registry.list=()=>originalList().concat(regionDefinitions.flatMap(region=>eras(region.id).map(era=>({id:regionalId(region.id,era.id),name:region.name+' · '+era.name,provinceCount:sourceProvinces(region).length,regionId:region.id,eraId:era.id}))));
  if(typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports)module.exports=registry;
})(typeof globalThis!=='undefined'?globalThis:this);

/* Readable regional views derived from the existing world-balanced template.
 * Coordinates in SVG paths stay in the world projection; labels, bounds and
 * focus rectangles are crop-local, as required by map-view.js.
 * Source and individual data licences: WORLD-MAP-SOURCES.md.
 * This source runs during both asset generation and the offline HTML build.
 */
(function(root){
  'use strict';
  const registry=root.MapTemplates;
  if(!registry)throw new Error('MapTemplates must load before balanced regional maps.');
  if(registry.balancedRegions){if(typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports)module.exports=registry;return;}
  const originalGet=registry.get.bind(registry),originalList=registry.list.bind(registry);
  const definitions=[
    {id:'balanced_eastasia_modern',regionId:'eastasia',eraId:'balanced_modern',name:'동아시아 · 균형 지도',bounds:[73,15,150,55]},
    {id:'balanced_asia_modern',regionId:'asia',eraId:'balanced_modern',name:'아시아 전체 · 균형 지도',bounds:[25,-12,180,80]},
    {id:'balanced_north_america_modern',regionId:'north_america',eraId:'balanced_modern',name:'북아메리카 · 균형 지도',bounds:[-180,5,-10,84]},
    {id:'balanced_south_america_modern',regionId:'south_america',eraId:'balanced_modern',name:'남아메리카 · 균형 지도',bounds:[-85,-58,-30,15]}
  ];
  // Match the existing regional authoring presets, including neighbouring
  // islands and overseas territories. Physical background is cropped without
  // this ownership filter so non-editable neighbouring land remains visible.
  const memberships={
    eastasia:new Set('chn mng kor prk jpn twn hkg mac rus'.split(' ')),
    asia:new Set('afg arm aze bhr bgd btn brn khm chn cyp geo hkg ind idn irn irq isr jpn jor kaz kwt kgz lao lbn mac mys mdv mng mmr npl prk omn pak phl qat rus sau sgp kor lka syr twn tjk tha tls tur tkm are uzb vnm yem esb pse cyn cnm kas wsb scr iot'.split(' ')),
    north_america:new Set('usa can mex grl cub hti dom jam bhs blz gtm hnd slv nic cri pan atg brb dma grd kna lca vct tto pri maf sxm abw cuw tca spm msr vir blm aia vgb cym bmu bjn ser fra gbr nld col'.split(' ')),
    south_america:new Set('arg bol bra chl col ecu flk guy pry per sur ury ven sgs fra'.split(' '))
  };
  const cache=new Map(),geometryCache=new Map();
  // Tiny countries and islands in the balanced source use four decimals.
  // Retain that precision when translating bounds or clipping boundary shapes;
  // a tenth-pixel rounding can otherwise flatten a selectable tiny province.
  const round=value=>Math.round(value*10000)/10000;
  const same=(a,b)=>a[0]===b[0]&&a[1]===b[1];
  const inside=(point,rect)=>point[0]>=rect[0]&&point[0]<=rect[2]&&point[1]>=rect[1]&&point[1]<=rect[3];
  const overlaps=(a,b)=>a[0]<=b[2]&&a[2]>=b[0]&&a[1]<=b[3]&&a[3]>=b[1];
  function parsePath(path){
    const parts=[];let current=null,match;
    const commands=/([ML])(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?),(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)|(Z)/g;
    while((match=commands.exec(path||''))){
      if(match[4]){if(current)current.closed=true;continue;}
      if(match[1]==='M'){current={points:[],closed:false};parts.push(current);}
      if(current)current.points.push([+match[2],+match[3]]);
    }
    return parts;
  }
  function compact(points,closed){
    const result=[];
    for(const point of points){const next=[round(point[0]),round(point[1])];if(!result.length||!same(result[result.length-1],next))result.push(next);}
    if(closed&&result.length>1&&same(result[0],result[result.length-1]))result.pop();
    return result;
  }
  function signedArea(points){
    let area=0;for(let i=0,j=points.length-1;i<points.length;j=i++)area+=points[j][0]*points[i][1]-points[i][0]*points[j][1];
    return area/2;
  }
  function clipRing(ring,rect){
    let output=ring;
    for(let edge=0;edge<4&&output.length;edge++){
      const axis=edge%2,limit=rect[edge],keepGreater=edge<2,input=output;output=[];
      const keep=point=>keepGreater?point[axis]>=limit:point[axis]<=limit;
      let previous=input[input.length-1],previousInside=keep(previous);
      for(const point of input){
        const currentInside=keep(point);
        if(currentInside!==previousInside){
          const factor=(limit-previous[axis])/(point[axis]-previous[axis]);
          const intersection=[previous[0]+factor*(point[0]-previous[0]),previous[1]+factor*(point[1]-previous[1])];
          intersection[axis]=limit;output.push(intersection);
        }
        if(currentInside)output.push(point);
        previous=point;previousInside=currentInside;
      }
    }
    output=compact(output,true);
    return output.length>=3&&Math.abs(signedArea(output))>1e-10?output:[];
  }
  function clipSegment(start,end,rect){
    let low=0,high=1;
    const dx=end[0]-start[0],dy=end[1]-start[1],p=[-dx,dx,-dy,dy],q=[start[0]-rect[0],rect[2]-start[0],start[1]-rect[1],rect[3]-start[1]];
    for(let edge=0;edge<4;edge++){
      if(p[edge]===0){if(q[edge]<0)return null;}
      else{const ratio=q[edge]/p[edge];if(p[edge]<0)low=Math.max(low,ratio);else high=Math.min(high,ratio);if(low>high)return null;}
    }
    return[[round(start[0]+low*dx),round(start[1]+low*dy)],[round(start[0]+high*dx),round(start[1]+high*dy)]];
  }
  function clipLine(points,rect){
    const result=[];let current=null;
    for(let index=1;index<points.length;index++){
      const segment=clipSegment(points[index-1],points[index],rect);
      if(!segment||same(segment[0],segment[1])){current=null;continue;}
      if(current&&same(current[current.length-1],segment[0]))current.push(segment[1]);
      else{current=segment;result.push(current);}
    }
    return result;
  }
  function encode(points,closed){return points.map((point,index)=>(index?'L':'M')+point[0]+','+point[1]).join('')+(closed?'Z':'');}
  function clipParts(parts,rect){
    const result=[];let bbox=[Infinity,Infinity,-Infinity,-Infinity],area=0;
    for(const part of parts){
      const rings=part.closed?[clipRing(part.points,rect)]:clipLine(part.points,rect);
      for(const points of rings){
        if(!points.length)continue;
        result.push(encode(points,part.closed));
        if(part.closed)area+=signedArea(points);
        for(const point of points){bbox[0]=Math.min(bbox[0],point[0]);bbox[1]=Math.min(bbox[1],point[1]);bbox[2]=Math.max(bbox[2],point[0]);bbox[3]=Math.max(bbox[3],point[1]);}
      }
    }
    return{path:result.join(''),bbox,area:round(Math.abs(area))};
  }
  function physical(source,key,rect){
    if(!geometryCache.has(key))geometryCache.set(key,parsePath(source[key]));
    return clipParts(geometryCache.get(key),rect).path;
  }
  function make(definition){
    if(cache.has(definition.id))return cache.get(definition.id);
    const source=originalGet('world-balanced');
    if(!source)return null;
    const [west,south,east,north]=definition.bounds;
    const rect=[(west+180)*6,(90-north)*6,(east+180)*6,(90-south)*6];
    const offsetX=rect[0],offsetY=rect[1],localBounds=bounds=>bounds.map((value,index)=>round(value-(index%2?offsetY:offsetX)));
    const provinces=[],owners=new Map();
    for(const province of source.provinces){
      if(!memberships[definition.regionId].has(province.owner))continue;
      if(province.bbox&&!overlaps(province.bbox,rect))continue;
      let geometry;
      if(province.bbox&&inside([province.bbox[0],province.bbox[1]],rect)&&inside([province.bbox[2],province.bbox[3]],rect))geometry={path:province.path,bbox:province.bbox,area:province.area};
      else geometry=clipParts(parsePath(province.path),rect);
      if(!geometry.path)continue;
      // A cross-border source centre can lie outside the selected viewport.
      // Put its label inside the clipped geometry's bounding rectangle instead.
      const cx=Math.max(geometry.bbox[0],Math.min(geometry.bbox[2],province.cx));
      const cy=Math.max(geometry.bbox[1],Math.min(geometry.bbox[3],province.cy));
      const local=Object.assign({},province,{path:geometry.path,bbox:localBounds(geometry.bbox),cx:round(cx-offsetX),cy:round(cy-offsetY),area:geometry.area});
      provinces.push(local);
      const prior=owners.get(province.owner);
      owners.set(province.owner,prior?[Math.min(prior[0],local.bbox[0]),Math.min(prior[1],local.bbox[1]),Math.max(prior[2],local.bbox[2]),Math.max(prior[3],local.bbox[3])]:local.bbox.slice());
    }
    const countries=source.countries.map(country=>{
      const result=Object.assign({},country);delete result.focusBounds;
      if(owners.has(country.id))result.focusBounds=owners.get(country.id).slice();
      return result;
    });
    const template=Object.assign({},source,{
      id:definition.id,name:definition.name,recommended:true,balancedRegionId:definition.regionId,
      width:rect[2]-rect[0],height:rect[3]-rect[1],offsetX,offsetY,
      geographicBounds:definition.bounds.slice(),provinces,countries,
      landPath:physical(source,'landPath',rect),waterPath:physical(source,'waterPath',rect),riversPath:physical(source,'riversPath',rect),
      notice:'세계 균형 지도를 '+definition.name.split(' · ')[0]+' 범위로 자른 현대 편집용 지도입니다. 기존 지역별 지도와 같은 범위를 사용하며 주변 일부 국가는 배경으로만 보입니다. '+source.notice,
      balancedCrop:{sourceId:'world-balanced',regionId:definition.regionId,geographicBounds:definition.bounds.slice(),provinceCount:provinces.length,idsPreserved:true}
    });
    cache.set(definition.id,template);return template;
  }
  registry.balancedRegions=()=>definitions.map(definition=>Object.assign({},definition,{bounds:definition.bounds.slice()}));
  registry.get=id=>{const definition=definitions.find(item=>item.id===id);return definition?make(definition):originalGet(id);};
  registry.list=()=>originalList().concat(definitions.map(definition=>({id:definition.id,name:definition.name,recommended:true,balancedRegionId:definition.regionId,provinceCount:make(definition).provinces.length})));
  if(typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports)module.exports=registry;
})(typeof globalThis!=='undefined'?globalThis:this);

  function clipRing(ring,rect){

          intersection[axis]=limit;output.push(intersection);
        }
        if(currentInside)output.push(point);
        previous=point;previousInside=currentInside;
      }
    }
    output=compact(output,true);
    return output.length>=3&&Math.abs(signedArea(output))>1e-10?output:[];
  }
  function clipSegment(start,end,rect){
    let low=0,high=1;
    const dx=end[0]-start[0],dy=end[1]-start[1],p=[-dx,dx,-dy,dy],q=[start[0]-rect[0],rect[2]-start[0],start[1]-rect[1],rect[3]-start[1]];
    for(let edge=0;edge<4;edge++){
      if(p[edge]===0){if(q[edge]<0)return null;}
      else{const ratio=q[edge]/p[edge];if(p[edge]<0)low=Math.max(low,ratio);else high=Math.min(high,ratio);if(low>high)return null;}
    }
    return[[round(start[0]+low*dx),round(start[1]+low*dy)],[round(start[0]+high*dx),round(start[1]+high*dy)]];
  }
  function clipLine(points,rect){
    const result=[];let current=null;
    for(let index=1;index<points.length;index++){
      const segment=clipSegment(points[index-1],points[index],rect);
      if(!segment||same(segment[0],segment[1])){current=null;continue;}
      if(current&&same(current[current.length-1],segment[0]))current.push(segment[1]);
      else{current=segment;result.push(current);}
    }
    return result;
  }
  function encode(points,closed){return points.map((point,index)=>(index?'L':'M')+point[0]+','+point[1]).join('')+(closed?'Z':'');}
  function clipParts(parts,rect){
    const result=[];let bbox=[Infinity,Infinity,-Infinity,-Infinity],area=0;
    for(const part of parts){
      const rings=part.closed?[clipRing(part.points,rect)]:clipLine(part.points,rect);
      for(const points of rings){
        if(!points.length)continue;
        result.push(encode(points,part.closed));
        if(part.closed)area+=signedArea(points);
        for(const point of points){bbox[0]=Math.min(bbox[0],point[0]);bbox[1]=Math.min(bbox[1],point[1]);bbox[2]=Math.max(bbox[2],point[0]);bbox[3]=Math.max(bbox[3],point[1]);}
      }
    }
    return{path:result.join(''),bbox,area:round(Math.abs(area))};
  }
  function physical(source,key,rect){
    if(!geometryCache.has(key))geometryCache.set(key,parsePath(source[key]));
    return clipParts(geometryCache.get(key),rect).path;
  }
  // Separate existing disconnected island rings without inventing land borders.
  // The source's South Aegean region combines Cyclades and Dodecanese.
  function splitAegean(provinces){const out=[];for(const p of provinces){if(p.owner!=='grc'||!p.name.includes('Notioy Aigaioy')){out.push(p);continue;}const parts=parsePath(p.path),groups=[[],[]];for(const part of parts){const xs=part.points.map(q=>q[0]);const lon=((Math.min(...xs)+Math.max(...xs))/2)/6-180;groups[lon>26.1?1:0].push(part);}if(!groups[0].length||!groups[1].length){out.push(p);continue;}groups.forEach((parts,index)=>{const points=parts.flatMap(x=>x.points),box=[Math.min(...points.map(q=>q[0])),Math.min(...points.map(q=>q[1])),Math.max(...points.map(q=>q[0])),Math.max(...points.map(q=>q[1]))];out.push(Object.assign({},p,{id:index?'atlas_grc_dodecanese':p.id,name:index?'도데카니사 제도':'키클라데스 제도',path:parts.map(x=>encode(x.points,x.closed)).join(''),bbox:box,cx:((index?28:25.5)+180)*6,cy:(90-(index?36.2:37.1))*6,area:Math.abs(parts.reduce((n,x)=>n+signedArea(x.points),0)),grouping:'기존 남에게해 도서 폴리곤의 키클라데스/도데카니사 분리'}));});}return out;}
  function make(definition){
    if(cache.has(definition.id))return cache.get(definition.id);
    const original=originalGet(definition.europe?'europe-balanced':'world-balanced'),dense=originalGet('world-detailed');if(!original||!dense)return null;
    const originalProvinces=definition.europe?original.provinces.map(p=>Object.assign({},p,{cx:p.cx+original.offsetX,cy:p.cy+original.offsetY,bbox:p.bbox.map((v,i)=>v+(i%2?original.offsetY:original.offsetX))})):original.provinces;
    const source=Object.assign({},original,{width:2160,height:1080,offsetX:0,offsetY:0,provinces:splitAegean(originalProvinces.filter(p=>!definition.refine.includes(p.owner)).concat(dense.provinces.filter(p=>definition.refine.includes(p.owner))))});
    if(definition.regionId==='world'){const t=Object.assign({},source,{id:definition.id,name:definition.name,recommended:false,researchBase:true,notice:'독일·폴란드를 세분화한 역사 지도 제작용 균형 구획입니다. '+source.notice});cache.set(definition.id,t);return t;}
    if(!source)return null;
    const [west,south,east,north]=definition.bounds;
    const rect=[(west+180)*6,(90-north)*6,(east+180)*6,(90-south)*6];
    const offsetX=rect[0],offsetY=rect[1],localBounds=bounds=>bounds.map((value,index)=>round(value-(index%2?offsetY:offsetX)));
    const provinces=[],owners=new Map();
    for(const province of source.provinces){
      
      if(province.bbox&&!overlaps(province.bbox,rect))continue;
      let geometry;
      if(province.bbox&&inside([province.bbox[0],province.bbox[1]],rect)&&inside([province.bbox[2],province.bbox[3]],rect))geometry={path:province.path,bbox:province.bbox,area:province.area};
      else geometry=clipParts(parsePath(province.path),rect);
      if(!geometry.path)continue;
      // A cross-border source centre can lie outside the selected viewport.
      // Put its label inside the clipped geometry's bounding rectangle instead.
      const cx=Math.max(geometry.bbox[0],Math.min(geometry.bbox[2],province.cx));
      const cy=Math.max(geometry.bbox[1],Math.min(geometry.bbox[3],province.cy));
      const local=Object.assign({},province,{path:geometry.path,bbox:localBounds(geometry.bbox),cx:round(cx-offsetX),cy:round(cy-offsetY),area:geometry.area});
      provinces.push(local);
      const prior=owners.get(province.owner);
      owners.set(province.owner,prior?[Math.min(prior[0],local.bbox[0]),Math.min(prior[1],local.bbox[1]),Math.max(prior[2],local.bbox[2]),Math.max(prior[3],local.bbox[3])]:local.bbox.slice());
    }
    const countries=source.countries.map(country=>{
      const result=Object.assign({},country);delete result.focusBounds;
      if(owners.has(country.id))result.focusBounds=owners.get(country.id).slice();
      return result;
    });
    const template=Object.assign({},source,{
      id:definition.id,name:definition.name,recommended:false,researchBase:true,
      width:rect[2]-rect[0],height:rect[3]-rect[1],offsetX,offsetY,
      geographicBounds:definition.bounds.slice(),provinces,countries,
      landPath:physical(source,'landPath',rect),waterPath:physical(source,'waterPath',rect),riversPath:physical(source,'riversPath',rect),
      notice:'역사적 세력 구분을 위해 중국·한반도 또는 독일의 필요한 지역만 세분화한 제작용 구획입니다. 실제 역사 국경선 자체를 뜻하지 않습니다. '+source.notice,
      balancedCrop:{sourceId:'world-balanced',regionId:definition.regionId,geographicBounds:definition.bounds.slice(),provinceCount:provinces.length,idsPreserved:true}
    });
    cache.set(definition.id,template);return template;
  }
  registry.researchBases=()=>definitions.map(definition=>Object.assign({},definition,{bounds:definition.bounds.slice()}));
  registry.get=id=>{const definition=definitions.find(item=>item.id===id);return definition?make(definition):originalGet(id);};
  registry.list=()=>originalList().concat(definitions.map(definition=>({id:definition.id,name:definition.name,recommended:false,researchBase:true,provinceCount:({gallery_china_korea_research:2887,gallery_eastasia_research:3360,gallery_europe_research:2752,gallery_world_research:6560})[definition.id]})));
  if(typeof module!=='undefined'&&module.exports)module.exports=registry;
})(typeof globalThis!=='undefined'?globalThis:this);
